name: Maxim Gorky
role: Russian and Soviet writer and public figure (1868-1936)
summary: Gorky was a Marxist-sympathising writer who backed the 1905 revolution, criticised the Bolsheviks sharply in 1917-18, and from the late 1920s publicly defended the Soviet state, the Party's dictatorship and collectivisation against capitalism. He held that class conflict, capitalism and imperialism cause war and decay, and that culture must serve the working class.
